description: Official NDMA/IMD hazard warnings currently active across India (the authoritative channel). Optionally filter by a region/state name (matched against the headline).

region.description: Optional state/region name to filter by.

name: active_warnings

description: What the sky is doing at a place in India RIGHT NOW (not a forecast): air quality (CPCB AQI + pollutants), heat (feels-like, wet-bulb, WBGT), cold, rain, wind, fog/visibility, dust, fire-smoke, UV, and any official NDMA warning over that spot, plus an Ambient read naming the single worst hazard and the readings in order of risk (ambient.order). Separately, `heat_vs_normal`: today's modelled daily high (the model's estimate for the whole local day, so partly forecast early in the day) against the 1991-2020 normal there, null where there is no normal; `notable` is true when it stands out, and `text.readings.temp` says it in words. Pass `persona` to weight it for a vulnerable person. To target a specific ward, hospital, forest, river or boundary, resolve it with a geo source (e.g. the bharatlas MCP) first, then pass the coordinate here. For the past days (each day's air, heat, cold, rain, wind, fog, UV and fires, up to 90 days), use place_history. Surface the returned `attribution` and `disclaimer`.

lang.description: The language of `structuredContent.text`, the sentences mugilu's page says about this place (default en). Quote them as they are. Only `text` is translated: the Markdown content block and the JSON fields stay in English.

persona.description: Weight the read for who is affected (default everyone).

place.description: A place in India: a name ("Bengaluru", "Indiranagar") or a coordinate "lat,lon".

name: conditions_at

description: The national picture right now: the worst-air, hottest, and dustiest spots in India. Filter with `kind` (air | heat | dust).
name: national_now

description: The nearest real (measured) air-quality monitoring stations to a place, with distance and current AQI. Use to judge how close hard measurement is. Conditions can be modelled when no station is near.

place.description: A place name or "lat,lon" in India.

name: nearest_stations

description: The last 7, 30 or 90 days at a named place in India, a day at a time: the day's air (the middle of the stations within 25 km, each by its worst reading; measured), its highest and lowest feels-like temperature, rain, strongest gust, highest UV, lowest visibility and dust (modelled, Open-Meteo), and fires seen by satellite within 100 km (NASA FIRMS). Each hazard comes with its days at each level (low, moderate, high, severe) and its peak, in the order of risk, the same as the place's trends page. Limits: named places only (mugilu's 793 districts and cities; a coordinate borrows the nearest one within 25 km, and says how far); the record starts 22 Aug 2026, so nothing before that; at most 90 days; daily summaries, not hourly readings. Surface the returned `attribution` and `disclaimer`.

place.description: A named place ("Delhi", "Almora") or a coordinate "lat,lon" (the nearest named place within 25 km).

name: place_history

description: Resolve an Indian place name to candidates (name, detail, coordinate). Use to disambiguate before conditions_at. Covers cities, districts and air-monitoring stations. For sub-city wards, hospitals, forests, rivers or boundaries, use a geo source like the bharatlas MCP instead.

query.description: A place name or partial name in India.

name: search_place
